question: Can you show me an emergency hospital within a 140 kilometers radius of Caldwell Woods, Chicago, IL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city, amenity, emergency FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'hospital' AND emergency = 'yes' AND ST_DWithin( pois.geometry::geography, (SELECT P.geometry::geography FROM parks AS P WHERE P.park_name ILIKE '%Caldwell Woods%' AND ST_Intersects(P.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry::geography FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), 140000 -- 140 kilometers in meters );
